item.title: Canada Day Celebration 2024
item.description: Canada Day Celebration 2024 Collaborators: Gibson House Museum Format: Public workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Carpet / Kilim / Tapestry weaving On Canada Day,2024, our team had the honor of collaborating with Gibson House Museum and holding an art workshop centered on traditional Iranian textiles. During this event, the arts of Persian carpet, kilim, and tapestry were introduced to the audience, and families were able to share a hands-on, inspiring experience of Iranian art together.

item.title: Group Workshops

item.title: Institutional Workshops
item.description: Workshops designed for museums, festivals, galleries, and organizations — combining demonstration, storytelling, and guided making.

item.title: March Break 2025
item.description: March Break 2025 Collaborators: Gibson House Museum Format: Public workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Carpet / Kilim weaving During March Break 2025, carpet and kilim weaving workshops were held in collaboration with the Gibson House Museum over five consecutive days. Most participants were children, accompanied by their parents, and took part in the workshops with great enthusiasm.

item.title: Private Classes
item.description: Private one-on-one (or small group) classes tailored to your level — from beginner foundations to advanced patterns and finishing. Typical topics Loom setup & warping Basic knots & weaving techniques Pattern reading & color planning Finishing and care

item.title: STACKT Market Workshop 2024
item.description: Weaving Dreams Workshop 2024 Collaborators: Sukoon Space at STACKT Market Format: Group workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Kilim Weaving A one-session introductory kilim weaving workshop was held in collaboration with the Sokoun Art Group. During the workshop, participants learned the basic techniques of kilim weaving, and each attendee received a ready-to-use weaving kit to continue practicing at home.

item.title: Willowdale Nowruz Celebration 2024
item.description: Willowdale Nowruz Celebration 2024 Collaborators: Willowdale City Office and Tirgan Organization Format: Public workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Carpet / Kilim / Tapestry weaving During the Nowruz Festival on March 9, 2024, our team had the pleasure of collaborating with Willowdale City Office and Tirgan Organization in holding an interactive Persian Carpet, Kilim and Tapestry workshop designed for attendees of all ages. Through individual training, we provided a brief overview of traditional weaving techniques, allowing participants to experience weaving the craft firsthand.

item.title: Willowdale Nowruz Celebration 2025
item.description: Willowdale Nowruz Celebration 2025 Collaborators: Willowdale City Office and SEED Foundation Format: Public workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Carpet / Kilim / Tapestry weaving Toranj Team returned to the Nowruz Festival for the second time on March 1, 2025, partnering once again with Willowdale City Office and Seed Foundation. To enhance the experience, we introduced a pre-registration system, allowing participants to sign up early and choose their specific areas of interest.
